prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.
Evidence is still thin for home, wait_info changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for adoption, redesign changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path, reorder changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in, notification changes (only 1 test).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -9.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality Selector Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection experience on pick_friend into dynamic cards highlighting pet personalities, desktop habits, and traits. (why: Adoption step has a 60.9% conversion rate with users spending a long median of 89s evaluating pets without clear personality context.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Quick-Start Card: Inserts a new quick-start screen before home_intro that clearly demonstrates desktop shortcuts for summoning, hiding, and chatting with the pet. (why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that logging in locks your pet data safely to your permanent account. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in under different accounts.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Pet Generation Progress Breakdown: Displays detailed phase-by-phase generation progress and estimated remaining render time on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating uncertainty while pet rendering completes.)
4: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Adoption Certificate Preview: Changes adoption_certificate layout to a side-by-side split view showing the certificate form alongside a live animated preview of the adopted pet. (why: Adoption screen completion drops to 60.9% and takes 89s median.)
5: [finish, new_flow] First-Day Companion Playground Guided Tour: Adds a multi-step interactive onboarding flow 'new_interactive_tour' introducing hands-on desktop interaction tasks prior to completing setup. (why: Finish step conversion is only 64.8% (median 395s) and multiple support emails note confusion over post-onboarding desktop features.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy: Clarifies the time commitment and outcome differences between Instant Preset Adoption and Custom AI Generation. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a large mean completion time (514s), indicating hesitation.)

Direct support ticket evidence with low execution cost via hint text.
Wait info previously showed +3.8% lift, addressing extreme waiting duration.
